description: Unit test class for the Device class, verifying JSON encoding/decoding behavior and properties related to device enablement and extensions.

classes.name: DeviceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests serialization and deserialization of the Device model, including default values, enabled flag, and extensions.

methods.name: testDecodeDefault
methods.description: Tests decoding a Device object from JSON with no 'enabled' field, verifying it results in a null getEnabled() value.

methods.name: testDecodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests decoding a Device object with 'enabled' set to false.

methods.name: testDecodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests decoding a Device object with 'enabled' set to true.

methods.name: testDecodeExt
methods.description: Tests decoding a Device object with an 'ext' map containing custom data.

methods.name: testEncodeDefault
methods.description: Tests encoding a default Device object to JSON, expecting absence of 'enabled' and 'ext' fields.

methods.name: testEncodeEnabled
methods.description: Tests encoding a Device object with 'enabled' set to true.

methods.name: testEncodeDisabled
methods.description: Tests encoding a Device object with 'enabled' set to false.
